description: Source code for expression handling in a configuration system, including expression creation, copying, freeing, comparison, transformation, and printing functions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_symbol
methods.description: Allocates an expression node representing a symbol.

methods.name: expr_alloc_one
methods.description: Allocates an expression node of a given type with one child expression.

methods.name: expr_alloc_two
methods.description: Allocates an expression node of a given type with two child expressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_comp
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression node between two symbols.

methods.name: expr_alloc_and
methods.description: Creates an AND expression from two expressions, simplifying if one is null.

methods.name: expr_alloc_or
methods.description: Creates an OR expression from two expressions, simplifying if one is null.

methods.name: expr_copy
methods.description: Deep copies an expression tree.

methods.name: expr_free
methods.description: Frees an expression tree.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_eq
methods.description: Rewrites two expression trees to eliminate common operands.

methods.name: expr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two expressions are equal after simplification.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_yn
methods.description: Simplifies expressions involving boolean constants y/n.

methods.name: expr_trans_bool
methods.description: Transforms expressions involving boolean negations.

methods.name: expr_join_or
methods.description: Attempts to join two OR expressions into a simplified form.

methods.name: expr_join_and
methods.description: Attempts to join two AND expressions into a simplified form.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_dups
methods.description: Removes duplicate operands from an expression.

methods.name: expr_transform
methods.description: Performs various logical and comparison simplifications on an expression.

methods.name: expr_contains_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_depends_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_trans_compare
methods.description: Inserts explicit comparisons of a specific type to a symbol into an expression.

methods.name: expr_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the boolean value of an expression.

methods.name: expr_compare_type
methods.description: Compares two expression types for ordering.

methods.name: expr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression using a callback function.

methods.name: expr_fprint
methods.description: Prints an expression to a FILE stream.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression to a grow string.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print_revdep
methods.description: Prints reverse dependency expressions with formatting.
